name: superpowers-github-scout
description: Independent evidence-led research and website design extension for agentic workflows.

interface.longDescription: Independent extension that finds and ranks research leads from GitHub and relevant communities. For website reconstruction it emphasises visual comparison and accessible interaction QA. The plugin itself is an instructions-only skill: it cannot intercept every ChatGPT message or call a local server without a configured tool.
defaultPrompt: Investigate the best approach for recreating this authorised website.
Find and compare open-source implementations for this bug.
Turn these project requirements into a testable implementation brief.
